From: Marco Petrosyan
To: Sylvia Nakamura
Subject: Quarterly tip reporting — looks off to me

Hi Sylvia,

Hope you're doing well. I was going over the numbers for this quarter, and the tip reporting just doesn't match what I'm seeing in our daily sheets. Something's off—either we're missing some shifts or there's a data entry issue somewhere.

Can you take a look and reconcile that with the actual cash and card tips we recorded? I need this cleared up before we file anything. Also, if you could give me a quick summary of what changed vs. last quarter, that'd be helpful.

Thanks—I appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

Best,
Marco

---

From: Sylvia Nakamura
To: Marco Petrosyan, Gabriel Fontes
Subject: Re: Quarterly tip reporting — looks off to me

Hi Marco,

Thanks for flagging this—I've reconciled the tip reporting against our daily sheets, and the dip is accounted for. Two factors are at play: a shift in the payment mix (more card, less cash) and a carryover effect from the May amendment to Blue Fir's Q1 Oregon withholding return, which corrected a tip-allocation error.

That amendment lowered the Q1 reported tips, and the adjustment carries into how the current quarter's figures reconcile. I've verified the daily sheets and the filing confirmation; everything lines up with what we recorded.

I need the final sign-off from both you and Gabriel by end of day today so we can proceed with the end-of-week filing as planned. If you'd like a line-by-line walkthrough, I'm happy to set up a quick call.

Best,
Sylvia

---

From: Marco Petrosyan
To: Sylvia Nakamura
Subject: Re: Quarterly tip reporting — looks off to me

Hi Sylvia,

Thanks for digging into this so fast. That explains it—I didn't remember the May amendment throwing things off, but it makes sense now. Appreciate you verifying the daily sheets and the filing confirmation.

I'm good with your numbers. I'll loop Gabriel in and we'll get you the sign-off by end of day. No need for a call unless something else pops up.

One thing—could you send me that quick summary of what changed vs. last quarter? I like to have that on hand for my own records, even if it's just a few bullet points.

Thanks again for the quick turnaround.

Best,
Marco

---

From: Marco Petrosyan
To: Sylvia Nakamura
Subject: Re: Quarterly tip reporting — looks off to me

Sylvia,

Got your summary, that's all I need. We're both signed off—Gabriel's on here too. Go ahead and file as planned. Thanks for the quick work on this.

Best,
Marco

---

From: Sylvia Nakamura
To: Gabriel Fontes, Marco Petrosyan
Subject: Quarterly tip reporting — reconciled summary and filing confirmation

Hi Gabriel and Marco,

Thank you both for the quick sign-off. As confirmed, I’ve reconciled the quarterly tip reporting against our daily sheets, and the figures are verified. Here is the consolidated summary of what changed versus last quarter:

- Payment mix shift: more card tips, less cash, which reduced reported tips relative to last quarter.
- Carryover effect from the May amendment to Blue Fir's Q1 Oregon withholding return: corrected a tip-allocation error, lowering Q1 reported tips and carrying into this quarter's reconciliation.

All daily sheets and the filing confirmation are consistent with what we recorded. I have everything in place to proceed with the end-of-week filing as planned.

Per our earlier discussion, I will submit the filing today by 16:30. If either of you needs anything before then, please let me know—otherwise, I’ll proceed.

Best,
Sylvia
